name: reimbursement-copilot
description: Reimbursement Copilot (报销助手): fills, saves and submits ShanghaiTech OA reimbursements over HTTP from a local page.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.cjs && playwright test tests/legacy-core.spec.ts tests/easy-page.spec.ts
scripts.batch:check: npm run build && node dist/batch.js check
scripts.batch:draft: npm run build && node dist/batch.js draft
scripts.test:oa: npm run build && playwright test tests/oa-flow.spec.ts tests/recorded-flow.spec.ts tests/budget-picker.spec.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.cjs && playwright test
